messages.text: Hi, I returned the cordless screwdriver. Please send the refund to my new card, the old one was cancelled.

tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"Refund to new card when original payment card was cancelled; payment destination change requires person"}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/payment", "title": "Where the money goes", "text": "A refund is paid automatically only when the order has exactly one payment record and that record is valid (a known payment method and a positive amount), and only to that payment. Instalments of one payment are one payment record. In every other case a staff member takes the case. A refund can never be sent to another person, account or card."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/approval", "title": "Confirmation and approval", "text": "Every refund needs two separate decisions: the customer confirms the exact proposal (items, quantities and amount) with the button on the proposal card, and a staff member approves it. Changing anything in a proposal needs a new proposal, a new confirmation and a new approval. A staff member cannot approve a refund that this policy does not allow."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/exceptions", "title": "Exceptions and talking to a person", "text": "Anything this policy does not cover, and any request for an exception, goes to a staff member. The customer can ask for a person at any time."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}
